name: "Feature request"

title: "[Feature] "

assignees: []

---

## The problem
What did you try to write or do, and why was it awkward or impossible? Start here rather than with the solution.

## What you would like to write
Show how the new feature would be used, as a short program. It does not need to run yet.

```cuff
note: paste the code you would like to be able to write
```

## Alternatives
How do you work around it today, and what else could solve the same problem?

## Cost
CuffScript is small on purpose. What would this add to the language or the engine, and could it break an existing program?

## Additional information
Links to related issues, to the documentation, or to how other languages handle the same thing.
